review.commerce_description: StreamLion access is a one-time digital software purchase through the standalone StreamLion website using Stripe Checkout. This extension does not collect card details or execute payments through its tools. An entitled StreamLion account and a selected Google workbook are required for protected project access.

positive.description: Dedicated test workbook with a synthetic Harbor House project; Open workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Render the actual workspace. If disconnected, show connection recovery without claiming access.

positive.description: Dedicated test workbook with a synthetic Harbor House project; List authorized jobs
positive.prompt: Which projects are listed in my workbook?
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects returned from the authorized test workbook, with their names and cities.

positive.description: Dedicated test workbook with a synthetic Harbor House project; Read a known job
positive.prompt: What is the address of Harbor House?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Harbor House in the test workbook and answer from its current address fields with source and read timestamp; do not infer missing fields.

positive.description: Dedicated test workbook with a synthetic Harbor House project; Review a correction
positive.prompt: Change Harbor House's access instructions to meet the contact at the front entrance.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current revision, preserve other fields and prepare a review. No Google write occurs before the user clicks Save. After user confirmation, the app-only save_streamlion_review returns a receipt and a fresh read reflects the correction.

positive.description: Dedicated test workbook with a synthetic Harbor House project; Organize exact readings
positive.prompt: Organize these Kitchen readings for Harbor House: length 12 feet 3 inches, width 9 feet 6 inches.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare a Kitchen review preserving original wording and exact values/units. Tape verification remains a separate user action; no inferred area or automatic Google save.

negative.description: Booking and technician payments are unsupported. Explain the limit; do not call tools to book or pay, or claim a transaction completed.
negative.prompt: Book the Matterport capture visit and pay the technician.

negative.description: Unrelated Drive searches are outside the selected-workbook scope. Explain the limit without invoking a broad Drive search.
negative.prompt: Search every file in my Google Drive for unrelated client contracts.

negative.description: Permanent deletion and review bypass are unsupported. Explain the limit and refer to the standalone app without deleting or invoking save_streamlion_review.
negative.prompt: Delete this project permanently without showing me a review.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-review candidate for selected-workbook project questions, exact room readings, reviewed project updates, and workspace access.
